title: From Data Localization to Digital Openness: Uzbekistan’s Regulatory Shift
gist: Uzbekistan is relaxing its data-localization stance to attract global platforms, as shown by talks between presidential administration head Saida Mirziyoyeva and Google VP Karan Bhatia on YouTube monetization.

insights.claim: Saida Mirziyoyeva met Google VP Karan Bhatia in New York in late September to discuss launching YouTube monetization in Uzbekistan.
insights.speaker: Elnora Anvarova
insights.so_what: Signals platform market entry and creator-economy monetization potential in Uzbekistan.

insights.claim: Uzbekistan's 2021 personal data law amendment restricting storage and processing of citizens' data abroad caused PayPal, Stripe, Netflix, Spotify and Amazon Web Services to stay out of the market and Apple Pay, Google Pay and Google Cloud to limit functionality.
insights.speaker: Elnora Anvarova
insights.so_what: Regulatory easing is the gating factor for global tech and fintech entry into Uzbekistan.
